text: When a family joins a plan during the visit, the bill should drop to member prices. Reprice does it in one step. Maria just signed Juniper up for a plan, but the bill still shows full prices.
Here is the total at full price.
Click Reprice to apply today's membership and discount prices.
Scout lists each line that would change. Drops are ticked for you.
The exam is now covered by the plan.
Other items get the member discount.
Here's the new total before you apply it.
Member prices, with covered lines marked.
If every line is already right, Scout says so. A line someone priced by hand is kept, and marked as priced by hand.
The most common mistakes are keying member prices by hand instead of repricing, and taking payment before repricing. Remember: Reprice before you take payment. Check the preview, then apply.
